name: Merkle Tree Verification
description: Vitalik/ArkLib-style Merkle tree proof: Z3 rejects proof acceptance without the hash_function_secure precondition, then verifies the collision-resistance contract and optional Lean certificate.

intro: Step 1: LLM generates Merkle proof verification code...
Step 2: mumei checks hash-function assumptions and root equality...
narrative.before: verify_merkle_root accepts a path computation without proving hash_function_secure or binding it to the expected root.
narrative.after: The corrected contract requires hash_function_secure and the collision-resistance equality before accepting the Merkle root.

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Missing hash_function_secure assumption
follow_up: Merkle proof acceptance must bind the computed root to a collision-resistant hash.
Buggy implementation returns leaf + sibling_hash without the security precondition.

pass.headline: Z3 verified Merkle root safety
follow_up: hash_function_secure == 1 is required before proof acceptance.
leaf + sibling_hash == expected_root and root == expected_root discharge the path proof.
Step 4: Optional Lean proof certifies the Merkle collision-resistance module...

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: missing hash security precondition
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 rejects Merkle root acceptance when hash_function_secure is omitted.

steps.name: Z3 Correct Merkle Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Mumei/Z3 accepts the Merkle proof once hash_function_secure and root equality are required.

steps.name: Lean Merkle Tree Proof Build
steps.verifier_gate: Lean certifies the Merkle tree module when the optional proof file exists.

steps.name: Lean Bridge Certificate
steps.verifier_gate: The bridge converts the Z3 certificate into a Lean certificate dry run.

harness_contract.intent: Prove Merkle proof acceptance requires hash-function security and root equality evidence.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records missing-hash-security rejection, Z3 proof acceptance, and optional Lean gates.
report.md explains the Merkle before/after proof evidence.
merkle_tree.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for the corrected Merkle contract.
merkle_tree.lean-cert.json is the L3 bridge certificate when Lean assets are available.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l3_lean; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Merkle root verification must require collision-resistance assumptions and bind computed root to expected root.
success_criteria: buggy proof acceptance is rejected for missing postcondition evidence.
Optional Lean build/bridge certifies Merkle proof assets when available.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: artifact gates preserve both rejection and proof-certificate evidence.
